title: Walk to Belmont/Vandy
description:
A comfortable and centrally located 2 bedroom apartment in the heart of Hip Hillsboro Village. Quiet and private with free parking, you are just steps away from tons of restaurants, bars, coffee shops and just a few blocks to Vanderbilt & Belmont.
Please note that the fifth sleeping space is the sofa which is not a pullout sofa

The space
This is a private apartment in an old historic apartment building. There are no shared spaces other than the back parking lot and you will have full access during your stay.

The apartment consists of one king size bedroom and one queen size bedroom, a full bath, full kitchen with laundry and living room area. There is also a small patio out front for you to use.

Guest access
Parking can be rough in this neighborhood so I would suggest walking or using Lyft/Uber

Other things to note
This space is so cozy that it stays cools in the summer and warm in the winter.

This is a basement apartment in a larger building. There is a potential of noise from above.

No deliveries
